body: Café de Flore for breakfast on day 1 — get there before 9 am to beat the queue.
Remember: Vatican Museums need separate tickets — book at least 3 weeks ahead.
7-Eleven onigiri breakfast = best decision ever. Convenience stores here are elite.
Negotiated motorbike rental down to $5/day. Always bargain with a smile.
